Back to Rebound

Your browser. Fewer distractions.

The optional Rebound Focus Guard is a free, open-source desktop extension for Chrome or Edge. It is an unpacked hackathon prototype, not a reviewed store listing.

  1. Download the extension ZIP and extract it into a folder.
  2. Open chrome://extensions or edge://extensions in that browser.
  3. Turn on Developer mode, choose Load unpacked, and select the extracted folder containing manifest.json.
  4. Reload Rebound in the same browser. Open Distraction guard, save your domains and YouTube channel allowlist, then start a timer.
  5. Check the connected status. Try a selected blocked site in a new tab. Turn off the extension or end the session to restore access.

What permissions do

Tabs and idle permissions estimate time on selected limited websites while the browser is active. Alarms update schedules. Declarative request rules block selected domains. Content scripts on YouTube and Instagram hide feeds and check the displayed video channel. A content script on the Rebound site transfers your chosen guard settings. The local preview address is included for development.

Extension usage counts, domains, and channel preferences are stored locally. It does not upload your browsing history. Your Rebound settings are also saved under your device key in the app’s cloud storage. Blocked-attempt counts use an unpacked-extension debugging API and are approximate.

Boundaries

Only this desktop browser is covered. It cannot block native phone apps, lock your home screen, prevent uninstalling, or stop use of other browsers or private profiles. Whole-site blocking uses the browser’s blocked-request page. Daily limits measure approximate active-tab time, not all device screen time. Enforcement updates within approximately 30 seconds while the browser runs.

YouTube Study Mode depends on its desktop page markup. It pauses video until the owner handle or channel ID matches your allowlist, hides recommendations and the home feed, and leaves search available. It does not inspect all possible embeds or replace supervised parental controls. External site changes can require updates. Blocking an entire domain overrides granular feed restrictions for that domain.

There is no comprehensive adult-content category database. Add known domains you want blocked. You can pause or uninstall the extension at any time. Never rely on it as tamper-proof enforcement.
